data.one_liner: Boolean operations on polygons (union, intersection, difference, xor).
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to compute union, intersection, difference and xor of 2‑D polygons. It clips polygons, removes unnecessary vertices and handles floating‑point edge cases.
use_when: Need polygon clipping or Boolean geometry in pure Dart
strengths: Pure Dart, works on all Flutter platforms
Sound null safety and simple API
Handles coincident segments and floating‑point irregularities
weaknesses: Limited to 2‑D polygons, no advanced spatial features
Performance may be lower than native libraries
